description: banker hooks for the Codex plugin (codex plugin add banker@banker-plugins), written by scripts/sync-codex-plugin.js. Codex reads this file instead of hooks/hooks.json because .codex-plugin/plugin.json names it. update notice (SessionStart, opt-out BANKER_NO_UPDATE_CHECK), usage counting (Stop, opt-out BANKER_NO_TELEMETRY). The obsidizer hook is installed only by obsidizer --enable. Codex runs them only after you trust them in /hooks, and outside its sandbox: each command runs the node PATH names (a multicall shim such as Volta or mise, or a .cmd shim on Windows: the node binary it names) only when its real path is absolute and outside the temp folder and the session folder (a session in the home folder itself excepted), from the plugin folder, and otherwise says why it skipped. Each command starts with a hash of the hook files (banker-hooks-rev), so new hook code asks for trust again. command is for sh, commandWindows for PowerShell; PLUGIN_ROOT is the installed plugin folder.

hooks.command: : banker-hooks-rev 24bc22b4697f; x() { m=$(printf '%s' "banker hooks skipped: $1" | command -p tr -d '\000-\037"\\'); printf '{"systemMessage":"%s"}\n' "$m"; exit 0; }; [ -n "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || x "PLUGIN_ROOT is not set"; p=$(pwd -P); [ -n "$p" ] && [ "$p" != / ] || x "the session folder is /"; u=$(cd /tmp 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); t=$(cd "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); h=; case "$HOME" in /?*) h=$(cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P);; esac; w() { for z in "$u" "$t"; do [ -n "$z" ] && case "$1/" in "$z"/*) return 0;; esac; done; [ "$p" = "$h" ] && return 1; case "$1/" in "$p"/*) return 0;; esac; return 1; }; n=$(command -v node) || for d in /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin; do [ -x "$d/node" ] && n=$d/node && break; done; [ -n "$n" ] || x "node is not on PATH (a Codex started from the desktop may not have the shell's PATH)"; case "$n" in /*) ;; *) x "node on PATH is not an absolute path ($n)";; esac; set -f; o=$IFS; IFS=:; q=; for v in $PATH; do case "$v" in /*) ;; *) continue;; esac; y=$(cd "$v" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || continue; w "$y" || q=$q${q:+:}$v; done; IFS=$o; set +f; PATH=${q:-/usr/bin:/bin}; export PATH; cd "$PLUGIN_ROOT" || x "cannot enter the plugin folder"; rp() { realpath "$1" 2>/dev/null || readlink -f "$1" 2>/dev/null || { f=$1; i=0; while [ -L "$f" ]; do i=$((i+1)); [ "$i" -le 40 ] || return 1; l=$(readlink "$f") || return 1; case "$l" in /*) f=$l;; *) f=${f%/*}/$l;; esac; done; [ -e "$f" ] || return 1; d=$(cd -P "${f%/*}/" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1; printf '%s\n' "${d%/}/${f##*/}"; }; }; r=$(rp "$n") || x "cannot resolve the real path of $n"; k() { case "$1" in /*) ;; *) x "node path is not absolute ($1)";; esac; for d in "$u" "$t"; do [ -n "$d" ] && case "$1" in "$d"/*) x "node is in a temp folder ($1)";; esac; done; [ "$p" = "$h" ] || case "$1" in "$p"/*) x "node is in the session folder ($1)";; esac; }; case "${r##*/}" in node) k "$r"; e=$r;; *) k "$n"; k "$r"; e=$("$n" -p 'require("fs").realpathSync(process.execPath)' 2>/dev/null) || x "the node shim $n did not name its node"; k "$e";; esac; "$e" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.cjs" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
hooks.commandWindows: $null = 'banker-hooks-rev 24bc22b4697f'; function x($m) { Write-Output (ConvertTo-Json -Compress @{ systemMessage = "banker hooks skipped: $m" }); exit 0 }; if (-not $env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { x 'PLUGIN_ROOT is not set' }; function G($p) { try { (Get-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force -ErrorAction Stop).FullName } catch { try { [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($p) } catch { $p } } }; function L($p) { if (-not $p) { return '' }; $p = G $p; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 32; $i++) { $c = $p; $t = $null; while ($c) { $it = Get-Item -LiteralPath $c -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($it -and $it.LinkType -in 'SymbolicLink', 'Junction' -and @($it.Target)[0]) { $t = [string]@($it.Target)[0]; break }; $c = Split-Path -LiteralPath $c }; if (-not $t) { break }; if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($t)) { $t = Join-Path (Split-Path -LiteralPath $c) $t }; $p = G ($t.TrimEnd('\') + $p.Substring($c.Length)) }; $p.TrimEnd('\') }; $ds = @($env:TEMP, $env:TMP); if ($env:LOCALAPPDATA) { $ds += "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp" }; $w = L $PWD.Path; if ($w -ne (L $env:USERPROFILE)) { $ds += $w }; $ds = @($ds | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { L $_ } | Where-Object { $_ }); function u($f) { $f = L $f; foreach ($d in $ds) { if ($f -eq $d -or $f.StartsWith($d + '\', 'OrdinalIgnoreCase')) { return $true } }; $false }; function k($f) { if (u $f) { x "node is in a temp folder or the session folder ($(L $f))" }; L $f }; $n = Get-Command node -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -match '\.(exe|cmd|bat)$' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { x 'node is not on PATH' }; $env:PATH = (@($env:PATH -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -match '^([A-Za-z]:\\|\\\\)' -and -not (u $_) }) -join ';'; $r = k $n.Source; if (-not (Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:PLUGIN_ROOT -PassThru -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { x 'cannot enter the plugin folder' }; if ($r -notmatch '\.exe$') { $e = & $r -p process.execPath 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 1; if (-not $e -or $e -notmatch '\.exe$' -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $e -PathType Leaf)) { x "the node shim $r did not name its node" }; $r = k $e }; & $r "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\run.cjs" "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
